# Drop to CDN

Upload files and publish HTML pages to public CDN URLs, then list, inspect, and delete hosted files.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/drop-to-cdn/.

## Actions

- **Get Account Usage** (read-only): Return the connected account's plan and current upload/storage usage context for deciding whether an upload is appropriate.
- **Get File** (read-only): Get metadata and the public CDN URL for one file or hosted page owned by the connected account.
- **List Files** (read-only): Return one newest-first page of files and hosted pages owned by the connected account, with a cursor for the next page.
- **Permanently Delete File**: Permanently and irreversibly delete a file or hosted page owned by the connected account.
- **Publish Page**: Publish HTML as a publicly hosted page and return its CDN URL.
- **Upload File**: Upload a file and return its public CDN URL and expiration metadata.
